title: Analysis result
description: What a provider returns for one submission, before it is written once to analysis_results (docs/db-schema.md). OpenAI is asked for exactly this shape with structured output; the legacy provider (Hugging Face + Virtual Writing Tutor) is mapped to it. Every field is required; null means that part was not available. Ajv checks every result against this file before it is saved.

ai_likelihood.description: How likely the text is to be AI-generated, 0-100. A signal, not proof.

flagged_sentences.description: Sentences copied word for word from the text that read as AI-generated, each with a short reason.

difficulty.description: How demanding the content is: 1 = easy, 2 = medium, 3 = hard.

grade_explanation.description: Plain-English explanation of the writing-quality score, for the student and lecturer.
